signature: SUBROUTINE ZLAQZ1( ILQ, ILZ, K, ISTARTM, ISTOPM, IHI, A, LDA, B, LDB, NQ, QSTART, Q, LDQ, NZ, ZSTART, Z, LDZ )

params.name: ilq
params.reference: Determines whether or not to update the matrix Q

params.name: ilz
params.reference: Determines whether or not to update the matrix Z

params.name: k
params.reference:
Index indicating the position of the bulge. On entry, the bulge is located in

```text
(A(k+1,k),B(k+1,k)).
On exit, the bulge is located in
(A(k+2,k+1),B(k+2,k+1)).
```

params.name: istopm
params.reference: Updates to (A,B) are restricted to (istartm:k+2,k:istopm). It is assumed without checking that istartm \<= k+1 and k+2 \<= istopm

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of A as declared in the calling procedure.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of B as declared in the calling procedure.

params.name: nq
params.reference: The order of the matrix Q

params.name: qstart
params.reference: Start index of the matrix Q. Rotations are applied To columns k+2-qStart:k+3-qStart of Q.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of Q as declared in the calling procedure.

params.name: nz
params.reference: The order of the matrix Z

params.name: zstart
params.reference: Start index of the matrix Z. Rotations are applied To columns k+1-qStart:k+2-qStart of Z.

params.name: ldz
params.reference: The leading dimension of Q as declared in the calling procedure.
